description:
Cast Sengir Autocrat by paying {3}{B}.
Sengir Autocrat enters the battlefield, creating three 0/1 Serf creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing the Serf tokens, adding {2}{B}.
Demon of Dark Schemes triggers three times, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sengir Autocrat, adding one mana of any color.
Demon of Dark Schemes triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Activate Demon of Dark Schemes by paying {2}{B} and {E}{E}{E}{E}, putting Sengir Autocrat from your graveyard onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.
